**Amber-Hunter v1.2.0 Changelog**

- Introduced `/ingest` endpoint: AI clients can now push memories for capture and review.
- Implemented multi-client integration: supports openclaw, Claude Code, Claude Cowork (local), and ChatGPT/Claude.ai (cloud) via unified API.
- Expanded memory category system to 8 universal domains with keyword-based auto-tagging.
- Added review queue endpoints (`/queue`, `/queue/{id}/approve`, `/queue/{id}/reject`, `/queue/{id}/edit`) for user validation of AI-initiated writes.
- Updated documentation for universal intake protocol, usage patterns, and endpoint security.
- Added core/llm.py and CLAUDE.md for improved LLM handling and integration notes.

**amber-hunter v0.8.5 Changelog**

- Removed all source code, scripts, documentation, and installation files from the repository.
- Project directory now contains only the unchanged SKILL.md documentation.

🎉 First release on ClawHub!

Amber-Hunter v0.8.4 brings full cross-platform support (macOS / Linux / Windows) with local-first AI memory capture, AES-256-GCM encryption, and zero-registration instant use.

Key highlights:
• /memories endpoint — no account needed, works immediately after install
• Proactive memory capture — auto-detects key moments from your AI sessions (corrections, decisions, discoveries)
• Active recall via /recall — semantic or keyword search, injects relevant memories into AI context
• E2E encrypted cloud sync — optional, requires huper.org account
• Cross-platform auto-start — LaunchAgent (macOS), systemd (Linux), Task Scheduler (Windows)
